Features and improvements in each release
Recents and Most used show apps based on how you actually use your phone.
This needs usage access, a special permission granted from system Settings — Facet can\'t request it directly. It only reads which apps you open and for how long; nothing leaves your device.
Notification badges show a dot or count on apps with something waiting for you, and the media player shows what\'s playing.

This needs notification access, a special permission granted from system Settings — Facet can\'t request it directly. It only reads which apps have active notifications and whether they\'re silent, plus the title, artist, and artwork of the media that\'s playing; nothing leaves your device.
A home screen that focuses on you.
No icon grid. Just your clock, what\'s next, and a few apps you actually open.
